title: Grilled Ukrainian Skewers with Peppery Onion
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring skewers of marinated meat and onions, grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, flour, and garlic powder. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
2. Cut onion into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. Add the beef mixture to the skewers, dividing it evenly among the onions.
4. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked through and the onions are tender.
5. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
